title: Image Registration of MALDI IMS to Microscopy
author: Nathan Heath Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bed2ja8e

steps.title: Generate MALDI IMS pixel map
steps.instruction: Use regToolboxMSRC (https://github.com/nhpatterson/regtoolboxmsrc) to generate a MALDI imaging mass spectrometry (IMS) pixel map.

steps.title: Select laser marks and IMS pixels
steps.instruction: In FIJI ImageJ, open the post‑acquisition autofluorescence (post‑AF) image and the IMS pixel map, then manually select the corresponding laser ablation marks on the post‑AF image and the matching IMS pixels on the IMS pixel map.

steps.title: Compute affine transformation
steps.instruction: Run the FIJI “Landmark Correspondences” plugin, set the post‑AF image as the source and the IMS pixel map as the template, and let the plugin calculate an affine transformation and resample the post‑AF image to the IMS pixel map coordinates.

steps.title: Align additional microscopy modalities
steps.instruction: Using regToolboxMSRC again, register the pre‑IMS acquisition autofluorescence, brightfield PAS, and multiplex immunofluorescence images to the newly saved post‑AF image (the transformed image from the previous step).

steps.title: Verify common sampling coordinates
steps.instruction: Confirm that all images are now sampled in the same coordinate system as the IMS pixel map.
